description: This file 'version.h' defines versioning information, external variables, and function prototypes related to the versioning and system info for the project. It includes external references to git version strings and functions for retrieving user agent info and system uname data.

methods.name: git_user_agent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string related to the repository or build environment.

methods.name: git_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.

methods.name: get_uname_info
methods.description: Attempts to get system information using uname(2), returns 0 on success, -1 on error, and fills provided buffer with system info.
